input.description: Run crow-nester outline on target page sorted by area
Fetch raw HTML of the page

events.text:
### Priority list
1. `#chart` canvas (bar chart) — largest rendered element (115200px² area) and the visual focal point of the page; its content is drawn entirely by inline script logic with no DOM/CSS backing it.
2. `h1` "Revenue this quarter" — full-width heading (46768px² area), the only text content on the page.

Note: the canvas content itself is normally "unrecreatable" (drawn via `ctx.fillRect` from JS-only data with no DOM signal), but in this case the page source is self-contained and includes the exact drawing script inline — so I can reproduce it exactly by carrying that script into the clone verbatim rather than approximating it. No red-twine/windtailor/slowcure calls are useful here: there's no repeated markup to componentize, no external stylesheet/computed-style ambiguity to resolve (page has zero CSS), and no JS-injected content beyond the canvas itself which I'm already copying faithfully.

input.content: Revenue this quarter

input.command:
cd /var/folders/gb/m6478s0n5mx9wqlz8t_c03800000gn/T/gumshoe-agent-run-plby5a && \
npx github:cam5/crow-nester file:///var/folders/gb/m6478s0n5mx9wqlz8t_c03800000gn/T/gumshoe-fixture-stage-yclo4k/page.html --screenshot original.png 2>&1 | tail -20 && \
npx github:cam5/crow-nester "file:///var/folders/gb/m6478s0n5mx9wqlz8t_c03800000gn/T/gumshoe-agent-run-plby5a/clone.html" --screenshot clone-round1.png 2>&1 | tail -20
cd /var/folders/gb/m6478s0n5mx9wqlz8t_c03800000gn/T/gumshoe-agent-run-plby5a && npx odiff-bin original.png clone-round1.png diff-round1.png --parsable-stdout

events.text:
Exit code 0 — pixel-perfect match, 0% difference.

- **Page contents**: a single `<main>` with an `<h1>` ("Revenue this quarter") and a `<canvas id="chart">` bar chart drawn by an inline script (`ctx.fillRect` bars, values `[40, 65, 30, 90, 55, 120]`, color `#017a07`). No stylesheet, no images, no fonts, no other markup.
- **Priority call**: crow-nester's area-sorted outline flagged the canvas (115200px²) and the h1 (46768px²) as the only two notable sections — correctly, since together they're the entire page.
- **Special handling / flagged item**: the canvas is normally the textbook "no tool can give you signal" case — its bars, values, and color live only in JS execution, not in any DOM/CSS a windtailor or slowcure pass could read. I flagged this rather than guessing. In this instance it was still fully recreatable because the page is self-contained and the exact drawing script is sitting right there in the raw HTML, so I carried that script into the clone verbatim instead of approximating the chart.
- **No componentization/theming work needed**: no repeated markup for red-twine to weigh in on, and no computed-style ambiguity for windtailor to resolve (zero external/cascaded CSS on the page).
- **Fidelity check**: screenshotted both `file://` pages at the same 1280×900 viewport (`original.png`, `clone-round1.png`) and ran odiff — result `0;0` (exit code 0), i.e. a pixel-perfect match. No further iteration rounds were needed.
